2. **A plate per shot:** a real frame of that shot at the source's aspect, with every drawn thing and every other face (a photo on the wall, a sticker) painted out, since HeyGen may animate the wrong face (`cv2.inpaint` for small marks, a temporal median where the person moves); it keeps the room sharp and true. Where drawn things are large or cross the person, an image edit cleans better (`hyperframes media-use generate --type image --reference <frame>`, asked to remove the text and keep everything else); check it kept the room sharp.
